mcp.notes: 2026-07-28 requires Mcp-Method header matching body method; tools/call also requires Mcp-Name.

endToEnd.covers: 分配→扣罐→撤销→回看→候选原则→确认→引用,含乐观锁/幂等/验签/413/四罐齐全

verification.ci: GitHub Actions job "verify" on every PR; red never merged

model.selection: env-var based; failure or timeout degrades to deterministic mock

safety.inputGate: keyword routing for self_harm / debt_loan / investment / generic_emotion; risky input never reaches the model
safety.crisisResponse: fixed copy with 24h helpline 12356, verified at the API layer by contract tests
safety.outputGate: 26-word forbidden list + max 3 sentences; one retry then safe fallback
safety.principleGate: first person, <=25 codepoints, evidence must reference reviewed stories; retry once then deterministic candidate
safety.auditEvents: risk type and rule only, never user text

privacy.storage: browser localStorage only; server persists nothing

knownGaps: 网页面的 CYCLE_REVIEW 与结余碎钻尚未接入(MCP 面可用)
